item.title: PRAIRIE PAWS NEW MOBILE CLINIC
item.description: Prairie Paws Animal Shelter has grown substantially and are now also the proud operators of animal shelters in Manhattan and Emporia. Realizing not every city can support an animal shelter, and even if they do, they might not have a surgery suite for spaying/neutering, they came up with a solution! A ribbon cutting was held Friday, February 20th to introduce Prairie Paw’s mobile clinic. Director Vanessa Cowie says a grant opportunity to allow Prairie Paws to make a big investment.

item.title: LIBRARY FUNDRAISING EFFORTS
item.description: The Ottawa Library held a very successful fundraising campaign recently and part of the funds came from the Patterson Foundation, who held a matching donation offer in November. Library Director Terry Chartier: The library continues to raise funds towards the renovation of the former Bottle House, in hope of turning it into a new library with more space for program expansion and community offerings. The library does hold larger events at the Walnut Street location.

item.title: YUTZY NEEDS MORE POWER
item.description: Yutzy Custom Structures in Garnett needs more power to complete their expansion. They want to upgrade their production facility to manufacture their own roofing tin and develop a truss manufacturing plant on site. They want to grow the employees to nearly 100 and add six more buildings to the site. item.title: Judyann Gilkey
item.description: Overbrook – Judyann Gilkey, 87, passed away on Wednesday, February 18, 2026, at her home near Overbrook, Kansas. She was born on January 11, 1939, in Cleveland, Ohio, the only daughter of James and Lillian “Lillie” (Sellers) Mudra. Judyann lived in Ohio until age 5 and then moved to Whittier, California where she grew up. She had lived near Overbrook for the last 30 years. Judyann had worked as a Paraprofessional for Santa Fe Trail School District for several years.
